operationalLimits.appliesTo: The emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 1 through 62, 89, and T1 through T6)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall only be operated in situations that arise from sudden and reasonably unforeseeable events where the primary energy or power source is disrupted or disconnected due to conditions beyond the control of an owner or operator of a facility including: A failure of the electrical grid; On-site disaster or equipment failure; or Public service emergencies such as flood, fire, natural disaster, or severe weather conditions. Also for participation in an ISO-declared emergency, scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT), unscheduled maintenance, testing, and operational training, and for the integration operational period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 24, 45, 46, and 61 through 89) and control device
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall be operated and maintained according to the manufacturer's written instructions or permittee-developed procedures approved by the engine manufacturer. Settings may only be changed if permitted by the manufacturer and do not increase air emissions.

operationalLimits.category: Ozone Season Operating Restrictions (MCRT, Testing, Training)
operationalLimits.appliesTo: No diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 24, 45, 46, and 61 through 89)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall be operated for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT), stack testing, or operational training (that involves fuel combustion) between the hours of 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30. Exceptions may be petitioned to the Regional Air Compliance Manager of DEQ's NRO.

operationalLimits.category: Ozone Season Operating Restrictions (Integration Operational Period)
operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 24, 45, 46, and 61 through 89)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: During the integration operational period, any operation (that involves fuel combustion) between 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during the ozone season (May 1 through September 30) shall only occur if the forecast Air Quality Index (AQI) for ozone for that day is less than or equal to 100. If an AirNow-EnviroFlash issues an Air Alert for AQI <= 100, operation shall be minimized to the maximum extent practical.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 24, 45, 46, 61, and 62)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall not operate more than 32 hours per year for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT). Annual limits for hours of operation shall be calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: The emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. No. 89)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall not operate more than 35 hours per year for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT). Annual limits for hours of operation shall be calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 1 through 62, 89, and T1 through T6)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall not operate more than 500 hours per year for all purposes (as provided in Condition 6). Annual limits for hours of operation shall be calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: The diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 1 through 89 and T1 through T6)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Approved fuel is diesel fuel oil, defined as ultra-low sulfur diesel fuel oil (ULSD), renewable diesel, or a blend of these fuels. Must meet ASTM D975 grade 1-D S15 or 2-D S15, or have a maximum sulfur content not to exceed 0.0015% by weight (15 ppm) and either a minimum cetane number of forty or maximum aromatic content of thirty-five volume percent.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: The emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 1 through 62, 89, and T1 through T6) and the non-emergency diesel engine gen-sets for all operations when emissions are not controlled by SCR (Ref. Nos. 63 through 88), combined
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall consume no more than 655,523 gallons of diesel fuel oil per year, calculated daily as the sum of each consecutive 365-day period (all uses).

operationalLimits.appliesTo: The non-emergency diesel engine gen-sets for all operations when emissions are controlled by SCR (Ref. Nos. 63 through 88), combined
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall consume no more than 226,000 gallons of diesel fuel oil per year, calculated daily as the sum of each consecutive 365-day period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: The transitory emergency engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. T1 through T6)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall only operate in support of the facility such as servicing as back up during construction, commissioning, and maintenance of the engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 1 through 89).
